lines.text: This is the lineage, and it is unbroken:
flower, slot machine, feed, and now the thing
that does not merely bait the reward circuit
but learns it, models it, predicts the lean-toward
a magnolia that grows a new perfume for each beetle,
in real time, forever, optimizing the gap before the having
with no dusk to close the bowl, no dawn to let you out.
